Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of BAC.
We delivered record revenue of $7.8 billion this quarter, representing 5% year-over-year growth.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 5% to 22% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2020.
Operating income reached $1.1 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Revenue guidance of $7.8 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. We generated $15.3 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
